wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A carries one row, 500.00. Cover line 1 prints LAST=zero-glyph, THIS=500.00, CUM=500.00, so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide (first and only report of the cycle). The Carr 5-5-PG sheet prints NO schedule total on Form A (it ends with the '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper ...)' line), so the cover line is the only anchor; schedule_total recorded null. Cover line 2 (le-$50 aggregate 75.00) is NEVER itemized and is deliberately excluded from the score per the sub-$50 aggregate rule.

expenditures.detail: Three rows 363.80 + 145.52 + 150.00 = 659.32, equal to cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (they coincide; LAST is the zero glyph). The filer also hand-wrote an UNLABELLED 659.32 on the ruled line below row 3 of Form B - it is the filer's own total, not a transaction, and is not emitted as a row; its arithmetic (363.80+145.52+150.00) is the proof it is a total. The form prints no schedule total of its own.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO page subtotal or schedule total on either schedule - stated, not invented. Gate run against the cover only: p2 rows 500.00 = cover line 1 THIS/CUM 500.00; p3 rows 659.32 = cover line 3 THIS/CUM 659.32. Both close exactly.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 -> 34 h-rules / 33 bands (status 'gaps'); p3 -> 28 h-rules / 26 bands (status 'gaps' - the detector lost several rules under the heavy fax speckle, the known tool DEBT). Counted by INK instead: p2 has exactly 1 inked writing line, p3 exactly 3 dated inked lines plus one wrapped continuation ('Chris Wilson', part of row 3) and the filer's unlabelled total line. Emitted 1 C row and 3 E rows - matches.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: first-row amount-cell crop (600dpi, x=4374 y=615 W=500 H=95) renders '500.00'; control one row-pitch below renders EMPTY. p3: first-row crop renders '363.80', last-row (row 3) crop renders '150.00'; the control one pitch below row 3 renders the top of the filer's unlabelled hand-written total 659.32 rather than empty - EXPECTED here, because the filer wrote his own total on that ruled line. No further ink below it.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the defect is the filer's. 500.00 (line 1) + 75.00 (line 2) - 659.32 (line 3) = -84.32, but cover line 4 'Balance at the end of this reporting period' prints 659.32 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells - i.e. the filer copied line 3 down onto line 4. Both figures retained verbatim; no anchor recomputed. Only report of this filer in this cycle in my chunk, so no cross-filing LAST->CUM chain test was possible.
